title: no test for pure select! closed() path
description: The select! { _ = live_tx.closed() => break } arm (line 334) has no direct test coverage. The existing test always sends a Chat broadcast after dropping the response, so the task exits via is_closed() in the empty-batch fallback, not via the select! arm. A regression that accidentally removes or breaks the select! closed() branch would not be caught. A second test variant that drops the response and waits without sending any broadcast would exercise the select! closed() arm directly and would fail if that branch were removed.
